thread:
maria: Heads-up — planned regional routing TTL change + controlled shard eviction rehearsal next Wed 2026-06-09 02:00-04:00 UTC. Not an incident; preparedness drill. Expect short p99 blips for long-streams.

raj: Regions and user-visible impact?

maria: In scope: west-1, eu-1, ap-southeast-1. Impact: transient p99 increases (~100-350ms) for pinned long-context streams while shards rebalance. KV prefix TTL for legacy routing keys goes 24h->12h which may spike cache-miss for ~12h post-rollout.

emily: Why reduce TTL? Rollback plan?

maria: Reduce TTL to reduce stale routing entries and enable quicker cross-region fallback. Rollback: flip FF off + deploy edge-router overlay (target <15m). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ttl-rollout

sre-bot: scheduled maintenance: 2026-06-09T02:00:00Z -> 2026-06-09T04:00:00Z (owner: @maria)

 tkhan: We should mute noisy pages. Which ones suppressed?

maria: Suppress LAT-STREAM-P99 and KV-BURN-01 (downgrade to SEV-WARN) for window. All other SEV1 remain active.

oncall-bot: quiet-window applied eng-sre 2026-06-09T01:50:00Z -> 2026-06-09T04:10:00Z

raj: Client-side guidance?

maria: Keep exponential backoff, enable jitter, don't increase concurrency. DevEx will release a reduced concurrency default toggle.

devex: PR: https://github.com/redwood/devex/pull/512 — temp maxConcurrency 8->4 when FF enabled for 24h.

emily: Canary plan?

maria: Phased roll:
1) 02:00-02:20 UTC canary west-1 5%
2) 02:20-03:00 increase west-1 30% + eu-1 canary 5%
3) 03:00-03:40 west-1 70%, eu-1 30%, ap-southeast-1 5%
4) 03:40-04:00 full rollout
Abort if p99 > baseline+500ms or kv-miss > 3x baseline.

raj: Where are thresholds?

maria: Playbook page: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rollouts-readiness — quick envs: ROLL_THRESHOLD_LAT_P99_MS=500, ROLL_THRESHOLD_KV_BURN=3x

sre-oncall: I'll be primary. Secondary?

maria: @tkhan secondary, @emily on biz-telemetry.

sre-oncall: I'll run canary commands. Snippets:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/router-region-west ROUTE_CANARY=0.05 --record
./ops/drain_shard --region west-1 --shard-id s-42 --soft-evict
```

maria: FYI we'll also enable an emergency fast-fail path: route-to-dedicated-tier if kv-burn > 5x. Notify customers if we hit rollback.

raj: Noted. I'll add dashboard panels and short alert note to paging policy.

emily: I'll monitor customer dashboards and post updates to #status when we start.

maria: Thanks all. Post-mortem not expected unless rollback triggered. :thumbsup:
